Exercise 9. a) It has begun to implement a new project to improve public transport; The city council approved it last month. b) Reduce traffic downtown and encourage people to use buses and bicycles instead of cars. c) The upgrading of twenty bus lines, new bike parking spaces near metro stations, the prohibition of entry into the center for old cars on weekdays. d) Environmentalists are welcome; worried about traders, who fear a drop in customers; They call for the ban to be postponed until after summer and for genuine dialogue with the shopkeepers. e) Three years, up to 40 EUR million; A poll of opinion. f) Examples: ⁧تَنْفِيذ⁩ (II, subject: ⁧مَشْرُوع⁩ ) · ⁧تَحْسِين⁩ (II, subject: ⁧النَّقْل⁩ ) · ⁧مُوَافَقَة⁩ (III, subject: ⁧المَجْلِس⁩ , preposition ⁧عَلَى⁩ ) · ⁧تَخْفِيف⁩ (II, subject: ⁧الاِزْدِحَام⁩ ) · ⁧تَشْجِيع⁩ (II, subject: ⁧السُّكَّان⁩ , preposition ⁧عَلَى⁩ ) · ⁧اِسْتِخْدَام⁩ (X, subject: ⁧الحَافِلَات⁩ ) · ⁧تَطْوِير⁩ (II, subject: ⁧خَطّ⁩ ) · ⁧إِنْشَاء⁩ (IV, subject: ⁧مَوَاقِف⁩ ) · ⁧مَنْع⁩ (I, subject: ⁧دُخُول⁩ ) · ⁧دُخُول⁩ (I, subject: ⁧السَّيَّارَات⁩ ) · ⁧مُعَاقَبَة⁩ (III, subject: ⁧السَّائِقِين⁩ ) · ⁧اِنْخِفَاض⁩ (VII, subject: ⁧عَدَد⁩ ) · ⁧تَأْجِيل⁩ (II, subject: ⁧تَطْبِيق⁩ ) · ⁧تَطْبِيق⁩ (II, subject: ⁧المَنْع⁩ ) · ⁧مُشَارَكَة⁩ (III, subject: ⁧السُّكَّان⁩ ) · ⁧بَدْء⁩ (I, subject: ⁧اسْتِطْلَاع⁩ ) · g) ⁧بَعْدَ أَنْ وَافَقَ عَلَيْهِ المَجْلِسُ⁩

Exercise 11. 1. After arriving at the airport, the delegation immediately headed to the Ministry's headquarters. 2. The company announced the cancellation of all its flights to the region due to bad weather. 3. The new law aims to strengthen the protection of personal data. 4. The increase in prices has led to a decrease in consumption (or: With the rise in prices, consumption has fallen). 5. The inhabitants asked for the school to reopen before the beginning of the school year. 6. Failure to comply with these procedures shall result in the rejection of the application. Delicate points: in 1 ⁧بَعْدَ وُصُولِ⁩ it is more natural with a verb (-) after arrival (-) in 5 a chain of three maṣdar ( ⁧إِعَادَةُ فَتْحِ⁩ … ⁧بَدْءِ⁩ ) shall be dissolved in English; in 6 The corresponding Italian administrative formulas are missing from the application. ⁧يُعْلِنُ مَرْكَزُ الحَيِّ عَنْ بَدْءِ دَوْرَةٍ مَجَّانِيَّةٍ لِتَعَلُّمِ العَرَبِيَّةِ لِلْمُبْتَدِئِينَ. التَّسْجِيلُ مَفْتُوحٌ حَتَّى الخَامِسَ عَشَرَ مِنَ⁩
⁧الشَّهْرِ، وَيَجِبُ إِحْضَارُ وَثِيقَةِ الهُوِيَّةِ عِنْدَ التَّسْجِيلِ. تُقَامُ الدُّرُوسُ يَوْمَيِ الثُّلَاثَاءِ وَالخَمِيسِ مِنَ السَّاعَةِ⁩
⁧السَّادِسَةِ إِلَى السَّاعَةِ الثَّامِنَةِ مَسَاءً. الحُضُورُ إِلْزَامِيٌّ، وَعَدَمُ الحُضُورِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ يُؤَدِّي إِلَى إِلْغَاءِ التَّسْجِيلِ.⁩
⁧يُرْجَى عَدَمُ اسْتِخْدَامِ الهَوَاتِفِ خِلَالَ الدَّرْسِ. لِلْحُصُولِ عَلَى مَعْلُومَاتٍ أُخْرَى، يُرْجَى الاِتِّصَالُ بِالمَرْكَزِ. شُكْرًا⁩
